## Summary

**Root cause found and cited**: The Owner's "an API called 11000 times" matches **11,165 real Anthropic Messages-API calls made on 2026-07-18 alone**, found in this box's own `~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl` Claude Code session transcripts (211 calls the day before, 6,999 the day after). Driven by **574 distinct parallel Claude Code sessions** running that single day vs. 14 the day before — not a single runaway loop, but an extreme spike in concurrent/serial session volume (the cron/systemd dispatch bug's retry storm + the already-flagged "uncoordinated parallel sessions" problem + normal gap-closure work, all landing on the same day).

Checked and ruled out with real evidence: OpenRouter (1,877 lifetime requests total via its real activity API — though it has a genuine, unexplained data gap for 07-08), Groq (no queryable usage API), GitHub Actions across all 3 repos (6,460/60/1 runs all-time, nothing close), and `costCapEnforcementEnabled`'s default-false bug (confirmed unrelated — different subsystem entirely).

**Prevention implemented**:
- Real per-invocation `--max-budget-usd` cap (default $100) added to `/opt/veridian/scripts/worker-entrypoint.sh` for every `claude -p` call, with a visible `blocked` status instead of silent continuation when hit. This script isn't git-tracked by any repo, so it's documented with a full diff in the RCA doc rather than a PR.
- Fixed the `AI_TEAM_LOG_SECRET` Vercel production gap (existed as a GitHub Secret since 07-08, never synced to Vercel — confirmed live and fixed by rotating a shared value into both).

**Deliverables**: `ai-os/INCIDENT_11K_API_CALLS_RCA.md` written with full cited evidence; tsc/lint/test(1766 pass)/build all clean; all 6 guardrail scripts pass; ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml updated; **PR #482** opened against `main`, held for your sign-off (not self-merged) since it touches cost-guard-adjacent infra.
